description_en: Add a keyword list to the meeting minutes
kebab_example: aliyun rtc create-cloud-note-phrases --app-id ac7N0000 --phrase '{"Description":"水果描述","WordWeights":[{}],"Name":"水果"}' --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateCloudNotePhrases

parameters.help_en: The application ID. Create and view this ID in the console. Only one ID is supported
parameters.help_zh: 应用ID。通过控制台创建和查询，仅支持传单个ID
parameters.name: app_id

fields.help_en: The description. It must be UTF-8 encoded and 1 to 200 characters long
fields.name: description

fields.help_en: The name of the hotword list. It must be UTF-8 encoded and 1 to 30 characters long
fields.help_zh: 热词表名称。UTF-8 编码，长度范围[1,30]
fields.name: name

fields.help_en:
The weight must be an integer from -6 to 5.

A value greater than 0 increases the chance the word is detected. A value less than 0 decreases this chance.

A value of -6 means the system will try to avoid detecting the word.

A value of 2 is common. If the effect is not noticeable, increase the weight. Note that a large weight can reduce recognition accuracy for other words
fields.help_zh:
权重取值范围为[-6,5]之间的整数。
取值大于0会增大该词语被识别的概率，小于0会减小该词语被识别的概率。
取值为-6：表示尽量不要识别出该词语。
取值为2：常用值。
如果效果不明显可以适当增加权重，但是当权重较大时可能会引起负面效果，导致其他词语识别不准确
fields.name: weight

fields.help_en:
Each word list can contain up to 300 hot words, and each hot word can be no longer than 10 Chinese characters.

Hot words must use UTF-8 encoding and cannot contain punctuation or special characters. If they do, the hot words have no effect.

The weight for each hot word must be an integer between -6 and 5, inclusive.

Numbers in text must be replaced with their spoken forms in Chinese characters. For example, replace “59.9 元” with “五十九点九元”
fields.help_zh:
每个词表最多包含300个热词，每个热词中文长度不超过10个字符。

热词必须为UTF-8编码，不能包含标点、特殊字符，不符合的情况下，无热词效果。

热词对应的权重取值范围为[-6,5]之间的整数。

文本中的数字需要按照发音替换为对应的汉字。例如：“59.9元”需要替换为“五十九点九元”
fields.name: word_weights

Id.description_en: The ID of the hotword list
